home.title: The trusted way <mark>abroad</mark>.
home.intro: Iraada brings students together with verified education and recruitment consultants. Find the right consultant, agree on everything in writing, and follow your application from the first message to the visa.
home.urduLine: بیرونِ ملک کا بھروسے مند راستہ
home.studentsTitle: Go abroad with people you can trust.
home.student1Body: See which consultants our team has verified, what they charge and which countries they cover, before you reach out.
home.student2Body: We suggest consultants who work with your country, field and level, and show you why each one is a match.
home.student3Body: Fees, deadlines and documents are kept in one place you and your consultant both see, instead of scattered across WhatsApp.
home.student4Body: Your profile stays private until you choose to let consultants find you, and nothing is shared before you accept.
home.agentsTitle: Let your record do the talking.
home.agent1Title: A verified badge for your agency
home.agent1Body: Submit your licence once. After our team reviews it, students see the Verified badge on your profile.
home.agent2Body: Meet students whose countries, fields and goals line up with the work you do best.
home.agent3Body: One link with your verified status, destinations and fees, ready for WhatsApp and Facebook.
home.agent4Body: New requests, active applications and upcoming deadlines in one view, so no student slips through.
home.stepsTitle: Three steps from first hello to boarding pass.
home.step1Body: Your studies, goals and dream destinations, shared only when you choose.
home.step2Body: Pick from your matches or accept a request. You decide who comes in.
home.step3Body: Track fees, documents and deadlines side by side, all the way to your visa.
home.closingTitle: Your next chapter starts with the right people.
home.closingBody: Join Iraada free and take the first step the trusted way.
home.checkTitle: Verify a letter on its own.
home.checkBody: Fake offer letters and visa documents cost families their savings every year. Upload any letter or message and find out in minutes whether it can be trusted, before you pay anything. Each report comes with an Urdu summary for your family, and you don't need a consultant or an application to use it.

policies.title: Rules and policies
policies.intro: What Iraada does, what it will never do, and the rules every student and consultant on Iraada works under. Written plainly, so you can hold us to them.

sections.title: What Iraada will never do
items: Say a document, consultant or opportunity is completely genuine or safe. The best result we give is "no red flags found".
Mark a consultant as verified because they pay for a plan. Only a completed review by Iraada staff verifies a consultant.
Read your Gmail, WhatsApp or any other account. We only check what you choose to submit.
Handle, hold or transfer your money.
Show your name to a consultant before you accept their connection.
Let an AI model lower a risk level. A model can add a red flag but can never remove one.

sections.title: How document checks work
items: Every finding says what was checked, the evidence behind it and the source that supports it.
The risk level is calculated in code from the red flags found, not decided by an AI model.
If a source is down or a check can't run, the report says so. A failed check is never treated as proof of fraud, and the result becomes "checks incomplete".
Always confirm with the issuer through contact details on their official website, never the ones printed in the document.

sections.title: Your documents and reports
items: Documents you check are read by our AI partners, Google Gemini and Groq, to prepare your report. We don't keep them.
A report is saved only if you tick "Save this report to my account" before the check. Anonymous and unticked checks are never stored.
A saved report never contains your document or the text you pasted. Names, payee details, account numbers, phones and emails are replaced with [removed].
You can delete your saved reports at any time. Nobody can edit them.
A report you link to an application stays private to you and Iraada staff. The consultant never sees it.

sections.title: Students' privacy and control
items: Your profile starts hidden. Consultants only find you if you turn on visibility.
Until you accept a connection, a consultant sees you only as "Student" and your field, never your name.
You decide which connection requests to accept. An application can only be opened after you accept.
Matches are suggestions based on what both profiles say. They aren't a promise of admission or a job.

sections.title: Rules for consultants
items: "Verified" appears only after Iraada staff review a licence or registration you submit. A paid plan never changes it.
The fees you list on your profile are shown to every signed-in student.
You can have at most 20 connection requests waiting at a time, so students aren't spammed.
Fee records, promises and the history of an application can't be edited or deleted once added.
Students can report misleading information, hidden fees, pressure tactics, harassment or impersonation. Iraada staff review every report and can suspend an account.
A trust card shows what a consultant told Iraada and whether our team verified a credential. It doesn't prove that every offer they send is genuine.

sections.title: Reports, disputes and suspension
items: Anyone can report a problem or raise a dispute about an application, on any plan.
A dispute is seen only by the person who raised it and Iraada staff.
Staff can suspend an account and must give a reason. A suspended account's profile disappears for everyone else.
Important account and application activity is kept in a history that can't be changed.

sections.title: Plans and payments
items: Iraada takes no payments on the site. Asking for a plan costs nothing, and staff approve each request.
Each plan includes a number of checks a month. A check counts when it starts.
A recorded payment in an application is what one side reported, not proof that money moved.
Plans add features. They never change a verification status or a risk level.
